caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular grid pattern composed of repeating geometric shapes in red, blue, and beige or light tan. The overall design creates a checkerboard effect with alternating blocks of color. The red sections contain a series of rectangles, squares, and small circles, all filled with finer grid and dot patterns. The blue sections are filled with dense, repetitive rectangular and square shapes with a three-dimensional appearance. Beige sections appear as background elements and as dividers between the colored blocks, featuring their own grid-like patterns. The entire pattern is bordered by a single row of alternating blue and beige rectangles. The composition is centered on a plain, off-white background. There is a handwritten signature near the lower right corner and a set of numbers or letters lightly written in pencil along the bottom edge of the drawing.
title: Handwoven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
